symptomes.alerte: See a doctor if the night sweats are heavy and keep going, especially with fever, cough or weight loss.

symptomes.syn: dizzy vertigo head spinning room spinning lightheaded lightheadedness

symptomes.alerte: Double vision or loss of vision that appears over a few hours or a few days is an emergency: call emergency services (15 or 112 in France) or go to an eye emergency department.

symptomes.nom: Stye: a red, painful bump on the edge of the eyelid
symptomes.alerte: Never squeeze a stye; warm compresses for 10 minutes, several times a day, help it come to a head. See a doctor if the whole eyelid swells and turns red, if your vision gets worse, if you have a fever, or if it doesn't heal within one to two weeks or keeps coming back.

symptomes.nom: Swollen eyelids, puffy eyes (especially when you wake up)
symptomes.alerte: Very swollen eyelids with difficulty breathing, or lips or tongue that swell: call emergency services (15 or 112 in France), as this may be a severe allergy. Also see a doctor if the swelling lasts or spreads to the legs, or if your urine becomes foamy or dark.
symptomes.syn: swollen eyelids swollen eyes puffy eyes bags under the eyes eyelid edema

symptomes.alerte: See an ENT doctor if the feeling lasts more than 3 to 4 weeks, if swallowing is difficult or painful, if your voice changes, if you lose weight for no reason or if you feel a lump in your neck. Acid reflux can also cause this feeling.
